messages:
liam: CI red on hosted integ smoke (shard21). Repro on multiple runs — auth-proxy returning 401s during streaming+tool-call paths and one test failing with a tool schema mismatch. Pinging infra for quick triage. https://ci.internal/runs/2005001234 :eyes:

ci-bot: Build 2005001234 failed (shard21). Tests: tool_call_handler.test_invoke_schema, streaming_integration.test_partial_frames. Logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/logs/2005001234

maya: I can take the initial rerun if ops agrees. Quick question — is this green->red or flaky on master?

liam: It flipped green->red after yesterday's infra deploy (around commit 9f8a7b2). Ran a local repro and saw identical 401s hitting auth-proxy when the runtime negotiates tool metadata during the stream handshake.

alex: Can you paste the failing assertion from the schema test? Might be a small payload shape change.

reviewer-jen: Failing snippet from shard logs:
```
E   AssertionError: unexpected field 'args' in tool_payload
  File "tests/tool_call_handler.py", line 78, in test_invoke_schema
    assert validate(payload)
```
Looks like the tool payload now includes an extra top-level args key in the streaming case.

sam: 401s + schema mismatch suggests auth proxy added stricter header checks and the streaming shim now attaches args differently when auth is present. Could be a header forwarding regression.

ops-bot: Rerun requested by maya: running shard21 rerun (attempt 1). Logs will appear at https://ci.internal/reruns/2005001234-1

maya: Repro command I used locally to simulate the streaming handoff (use dev creds):
```bash
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.1" \
  https://hosted-api.dev/stream?model=tool-test
```
On dev proxy this yields a 200 and payload with no args key. On CI auth-proxy we get 401 and a different shape.

alex: If the deploy changed proxy rules, can we bisect the infra commits between yesterday and when green last known? Candidate range: 9f8a7b2..c3d4e5f. I can run an infra bisect if ops gives a slot.

liam: Agree. If bisect points at proxy config change, we can either roll back or add a temporary header compatibility shim in the streaming client.

ops-bot: Rerun completed (attempt 1): shard21 -> still failing (401 + tool schema).

maya: I'll kick a parallel rerun with verbose auth logs on (shard21+debug). Adding header trace: X-Auth-Trace.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by maya: running shard21 rerun (attempt 2, auth-verbose).

reviewer-jen: While reruns run — quick workaround idea: modify the test harness to accept the extra 'args' key for now so the suite is not blocked by CI red. We should avoid masking real regressions, but gives time for bisect. Thoughts? :thinking:

sam: +1 for short-lived test leniency in a protected feature-flagged way. Create a small PR that only adjusts the assertion and gates it behind an env var TEST_ALLOW_TOOL_ARGS until root cause resolved.

alex: I'll start bisecting infra commits in the range mentioned. If anyone has the exact deploy ID, drop it here; that speeds it up.

liam: Deploy id was deploy-2026-03-15-18:42 (I'll DM ops the exact infra change list).

ops-bot: Rerun completed (attempt 2): shard21 -> still failing. Auth verbose logs attached: https://ci.internal/reruns/2005001234-2/logs

maya: Auth-verbose confirms proxied request lacked X-Request-Id header in CI runs after the deploy, which the new proxy version treats as tampered and returns 401. Also saw the streaming shim add 'args' during reserialization in the proxy.

liam: Great find. If proxy version enforces X-Request-Id, a compatibility shim adding a generated id when missing could fix CI quickly. Will open PR to runtime shim + test-gate.

reviewer-jen: Please include a clear note in the PR about being a short-term compatibility fix and track with an issue to remove after infra roll forward.

sam: I'll prep the small PR to relax the test assertion behind TEST_ALLOW_TOOL_ARGS and include a pointer to the runtime shim PR.

alex: Bisect progress: candidate commit identified c3d4e5f -> introduced stricter header enforcement in auth-proxy. Holding on rollback decision until we have a mitigation PR.

liam: Plan: 1) sam opens test-gate PR (short), 2) I open runtime shim PR to add X-Request-Id generation + remove extra 'args' reserialization, 3) merge both to unbreak CI, 4) ops schedules rolling rollback or configuration adjustment with infra. Thanks team.

maya: Sounds good. If anyone needs me to watch a deploy or help validate, ping me.

liam: Thanks everyone — filing tracking issue INFRA-3219 and linking PRs. Will update thread with PR links and CI status. :white_check_mark:
